outcome: PPH with atony and uterotonic administration
cohort: Women with twin gestations who delivered at greater than 23 weeks of gestational age at a single, tertiary medical center from 2011 to 2016
finding: Several maternal and peripartum factors, including nulliparity, diabetes, magnesium sulfate use, low hematocrit/platelets, general anesthesia, and cesarean delivery, were associated with PPH requiring red blood cell transfusion in twin gestations.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with PPH requiring red blood cell transfusion.
